data.name: Rage Powers
data.description: The following rage powers complement the scarred rager archetype - auspicious mark*, body bludgeon*, come and get me**, increased damage reduction, inspire ferocity**, internal fortitude, intimidating glare, reckless abandon**, regenerative vigor*, renewed life*, renewed vigor, renewed vitality*, roused anger, and terrifying howl.
